jobs.description: Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets. We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers. Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading. In this role, you will lead and improve the operations that are directly linked to our products. Your work will directly impact our operational integrity notably by enhancing fraud detection, streamlining customer support processes, or managing cash projections. All of which are critical to delivering a trustworthy and seamless experience for our users. This dedicated product operations position was triggered by the launch of new offer types within our product, and the scope of the role will expand as we innovate with our product. Our Benefits: At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life. Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role. Mental health coaching to support your well-being. Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections. The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company. jobs.title: Senior Sourcing Specialist
jobs.description: Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction . Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people , making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone. THE TEAM • ~160 people , around half in engineering, product and data • 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research • Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle • An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking , tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation About the Role This isn't a typical sourcing job. You won't be handed a list of open roles and asked to find candidates for each one. Sourcing role by role means every hire starts from nothing; we want strong people already in conversation with us before a role opens. You'll run a sourcing function of one that combines AI agents, market intelligence and an engaged talent community. That means owning three things: talent pools that are already warm, market maps that are current, and an employee referral scheme that works as a real hiring channel. You'll report to the Director of Talent and have a high level of ownership and autonomy. How you get there is for you to decide. We expect you to try new approaches, learn from what works and drop what doesn't. jobs.description: Qui sommes-nous ? SPRiNG est une marque innovante de lessive et de produits d’entretien, créée en 2020 pour proposer une nouvelle manière de consommer tout en réduisant l’effet des produits d’entretien sur la santé et sur l’environnement. Nous sommes en pleine croissance et cherchons un Chef de Projet Supply Chain & Data pour renforcer notre équipe Opérations. Ton rôle Nous recherchons notre futur·e Chef·fe de projet Supply Chain & Data. Ta mission : garantir à nos clients le meilleur niveau de service possible sur l'ensemble de nos produits, en pilotant nos opérations et en t'appuyant sur la data pour les améliorer en continu. Tes missions Opérationnel et amélioration continue Être responsable des process opérationnels qui assurent le bon fonctionnement de notre supply chain Co-animer le process S&OP : construire le prévisionnel des ventes, anticiper les bons niveaux de stock et piloter les flux Suivre et challenger la performance de nos partenaires logistiques Analyser nos données de flux, de stocks et de coûts pour identifier des pistes d'optimisation opérationnelles et stratégiques Analyses stratégiques et gestion de projet Épauler notre Head of Operations sur des analyses opérationnelles et financières Évaluer le potentiel et les risques de chaque opportunité, puis piloter la mise en œuvre des projets retenus Ce que ce stage t'apportera Vivre de l'intérieur le développement d'une start-up en pleine croissance Un rôle très hands-on, en prise directe avec le terrain Des missions variées et un impact direct sur la stratégie et le succès de la marque Le choix de ta ville : rejoins-nous à Paris ou à Barcelone Étudiant·e en Bac+4/5, école d'ingénieur ou de commerce À l'aise avec les chiffres et Excel, esprit d'analyse et grande rigueur Esprit entrepreneurial, goût de l'opérationnel et du terrain Autonome, proactif·ve, positif·ve et débrouillard·e Envie de t'engager dans une entreprise à mission Anglais opérationnel ; l'espagnol est un plus Find Jobs in France on Arbe

jobs.title: Customer Operations Director
jobs.description: Customer Operations Director Do you know how to combine customer focus, commercial awareness and operational excellence? As Customer Operations Director, you will lead our customer service, order management and sales support teams across our international Building Automation markets. Your goal is to make sure customers and partners get fast, reliable and consistent service, from their first question to final delivery. This role is for a leader who sees the bigger picture and knows how to turn it into effective day-to-day operations. What will you do? You are responsible for the full customer journey after first contact. That covers answering customer questions and requests, processing orders, following up on quotes, and coordinating deliveries and service. You work closely with Sales, Technical Support, Supply Chain and Finance. You will: Lead and develop teams across multiple countries: set clear roles, coach team leaders, and manage capacity and service levels. Bring customer service, order management and sales support together into one way of working, with clear ownership and smooth handovers between teams and countries. Support Sales: handle incoming requests, follow up on quotes and orders, and keep customer data in the CRM accurate. Sales keeps ownership of accounts, pricing and targets. Set up a clear process for technical customer questions with our Technical Support team, from first response to escalation. Work with Supply Chain on product availability and delivery dates, and keep customers and Sales informed when issues come up. Simplify processes, reduce manual work, and standardize ways of working across countries while respecting local language and market needs. Work with IT to improve how teams use our CRM, order management system and customer portals. Use customer feedback and data to improve service, and share insights with Sales and Product. Lead the organization through change together with HR and country managers, while keeping service levels high

jobs.title: Senior Supply Chain Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Du willst Lieferketten nicht nur verwalten, sondern wirklich gestalten? Bei Rosental Organics übernimmst du die volle Ownership über unsere internationale Beschaffung von Verpackungsmaterialien bis zu Produktkomponenten und baust die Prozesse auf, die unser Wachstum tragen. Du stellst die permanente Verfügbarkeit aller Verpackungsmaterialien und Produktkomponenten sicher. Engpässe verhinderst du, bevor sie entstehen. Du hältst eine stabile Bestandsreichweite von 1–6 Monaten für alle relevanten Produkte und passt sie kontinuierlich an den Forecast an. Du verhandelst aktiv mit chinesischen Lieferanten und reduzierst die COGS nachhaltig durch starke Konditionen und strategische Partnerschaften. Du baust belastbare Prozesse für die Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Lieferanten auf, inklusive vollständiger Compliance-Dokumentation und klarer Kommunikationswege. Du entwickelst und pflegst klare SOPs und sorgst für eine reibungslose Zusammenarbeit mit allen internen Schnittstellen. Du hast nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Verhandlung mit chinesischen Lieferanten. Du kennst die Hebel und holst das Beste für das Unternehmen heraus. Du bringst interkulturelle Kompetenz im China-Kontext mit und weißt, wie Kommunikation dort funktioniert (und nutzt das als Vorteil). Du erstellst stabile, datenbasierte Forecasts und Bestandsplanungen, idealerweise mit Erfahrung in gängigen ERP- oder Planning-Tools. Du behältst den Überblick über Bestände, Liefertermine und Produktionspläne, auch wenn viele Variablen gleichzeitig in Bewegung sind. Du denkst in Prozessen: Du erkennst, was ineffizient läuft, gestaltest bessere Abläufe und bringst andere mit auf den Weg. Du kommunizierst auf Englisch und Deutsch verhandlungssicher. Chinesisch ist ein klares Plus. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Senior AI & Automation Operations Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Auf dem Weg zu 100 Mio. € Umsatz wollen wir smarter, schneller und effizienter skalieren. In dieser neu geschaffenen Rolle machst du AI und Automatisierung zu unserem echten Wettbewerbsvorteil: Du findest die größten Effizienzhebel in allen Departments, baust die Lösungen selbst und bringst sie in den produktiven Alltag. Gemessen wird dein Erfolg nicht an koordinierten Projekten, sondern an eingesparter Zeit, besseren Prozessen und messbarem Impact. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unserer Teamlead Strategy & Operations zusammen und treibst eigene Initiativen voran. Du findest die größten AI- und Automatisierungspotenziale in unseren Departments und setzt sie konsequent um, vom ersten Test bis zum skalierten Rollout. No-Code- und Low-Code-Automationen, AI-Workflows und Agents baust du eigenständig, etwa mit Claude, n8n oder Make. Gemeinsam mit den Departments analysierst du operative Bottlenecks und gestaltest End-to-End-Workflows neu: vereinfachen, automatisieren oder ganz streichen. Zeitersparnis, Qualität und Adoption deiner Lösungen misst du und optimierst so lange, bis sie wirklich funktionieren. Teams befähigst du, AI selbstständig im Alltag einzusetzen. Auch Standards für AI Governance, Wissen und Onboarding gehören zu deinen Aufgaben. Geht eine Lösung über No-Code hinaus, schreibst du die Anforderungen für unser Development-Team und bleibst für Umsetzung und Business Impact verantwortlich. Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Operations, Business Process Automation oder Operational Excellence bringst du mit, idealerweise aus E-Commerce oder einem schnell wachsenden Scale-up. Mindestens zwei selbst umgesetzte Automations- oder Transformationsprojekte kannst du konkret zeigen: mit Ausgangsproblem, deinem eigenen Beitrag und messbarem Ergebnis. Mit AI-Tools wie Claude und No-Code- oder Low-Code-Plattformen wie n8n oder Make arbeitest du routiniert im Tagesgeschäft. Workflows, Systemintegrationen, APIs und Datenflüsse verstehst du technisch sicher, ohne selbst Software zu entwick

The Portfolio Data Operations team sits at the nexus of Addepar s activity and requires daily communications with data providers, clients, and other personnel within Data Operations and across the firm.  Applicants must have, and maintain, the right to work in the United Kingdom from the first day of employment. Entre inflation réglementaire et évolutions légales et conventionnelles incessantes, la conformité est devenue un véritable fardeau pour les cabinets de paie et les services RH : ce fardeau les empêche de se consacrer à ce qui compte vraiment, le conseil et l'accompagnement des salariés, qui en subissent donc eux aussi le poids ; c'est aussi l'un des métiers où l'attrition est la plus forte en France, notamment parce que 60 % du temps des gestionnaires de paie est encore consacré à de la saisie ou à de la relecture manuelle. Pourtant, des solutions technologiques majeures existent : l'IA permet en particulier d'automatiser une très grande partie des tâches les plus pénibles et de valoriser les données sociales. Mais le secteur reste largement à l'écart de cette révolution, et le problème n'est pas seulement réglementaire : le marché était verrouillé par des éditeurs historiques vieillissants, difficiles à quitter faute d'alternative crédible et de moyens pour migrer efficacement. Là aussi, l'IA fait voler ces barrières en éclats et ouvre la voie à une vague d'innovation attendue depuis des décennies. C'est pour y répondre qu'Alassio construit la plateforme de paie et de gestion RH moderne qui manquait à ce marché , au service des cabinets et de leurs clients TPE/PME. jobs.title: Company Driver
jobs.description: Company Driver Job Overview: We are looking for a dependable Logistics Company Driver to ensure the safe, timely, and accurate delivery of goods to various locations. You will be responsible for operating company vehicles, maintaining their roadworthiness, and representing the company with professionalism on the road. Key Responsibilities: Safely transport and deliver goods to designated clients and locations within Metro Manila and nearby provinces. Plan and navigate the most efficient delivery routes to ensure on-time performance. Conduct routine pre-trip and post-trip vehicle inspections. Perform basic mechanical and electrical troubleshooting, and immediately report major vehicle issues. Secure cargo properly and assist with loading and unloading as required. Maintain accurate delivery logs, route records, and vehicle maintenance reports. Communicate effectively with the dispatch team regarding delivery status, traffic delays, or route changes. Qualifications: Valid Professional Driver's License: Must possess Restriction Codes A, A1, B, B1, and B2. Experience: 2-3 years of proven driving and delivery experience within the limits of your license restriction codes. Technical Skills: Basic knowledge of vehicle troubleshooting (mechanical and electrical). A TESDA NC2 certificate is a strong advantage. Navigation: Extensive familiarity with Metro Manila routes, as well as nearby provinces. Character: Excellent driving record, good moral character, and strong communication skills. Flexibility: Highly adaptable with the ability to multitask, work shifting schedules (Day, Mid, Night), and take days off on a rotating basis. Location: Willing to be assigned to Elisco Rd., Ibayo Tipas, Taguig City. Availability: Can start immediately. How to Apply: Please submit your updated resume/CV through Kalibrr. Applications without an attached resume will not be considered.

jobs.title: Agile Program Manager
jobs.description: We're looking for an experienced Agile Program Manager to lead delivery across multiple cross-functional teams working toward a shared set of business outcomes. You'll sit at the intersection of strategy and execution: translating roadmap priorities into coordinated, predictable delivery, keeping dependencies visible, and making sure the right people are making the right decisions at the right time. This is a hands-on program role, not a status-reporting one. You'll own the cadence, the plan, and the risks across several Agile teams, and you'll be the person stakeholders trust to tell them where things really stand. What You'll Do Lead end-to-end delivery of a multi-team program, coordinating three or more Agile teams (Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid) toward shared quarterly objectives. Run program-level planning, including quarterly/PI planning, roadmap alignment, capacity planning, and release planning. Identify, map, and actively manage cross-team dependencies, risks, and blockers, escalating early and with clear options. Facilitate program ceremonies such as Scrum of Scrums, program syncs, system demos, and retrospectives, and make sure they produce decisions, not just updates. Partner with Product Owners and Product Managers to keep backlogs prioritized, refined, and aligned to business value. Build and maintain program-level reporting: delivery health, burn-up/velocity trends, OKR or objective progress, and RAID logs, tailored for both team-level and executive audiences. Drive continuous improvement in delivery practices, tooling, and team workflows, coaching teams and leaders on Agile principles where needed. Manage stakeholder communication across engineering, product, design, business, and leadership, keeping expectations aligned as scope and priorities shift. Track program budget, resourcing, and vendor or third-party deliverables where applicable. jobs.description: About Mecka AI Mecka AI is building the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI. We design and operate global systems for data capture, data labeling, and hardware-enabled workflows used by leading AI labs and robotics companies to train and validate humanoid and embodied AI systems. We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real-world data, simulation, learning-based systems, and deployed hardware. About the Role Signing a capture partner is the start of the work. Getting that partner to steady, high-quality output takes onboarding, training, hardware, support, and reporting, and every step has to run on time. As Partnership Operations Manager, you will own that path for our regional partnership leads so they can focus on finding and signing partners. This is a new function, so you will set the standards and tooling yourself and make them repeatable across regions. Partner support: Be the first point of contact for partners, and run the support channel to clear service levels.
